spiritgiven.comments: What a great team to play on our first game. We had a few calls back and forth, but all were handled with good communication and good spirit. Both teams had examples of where they made calls that did not benefit them. That seems the height of our game.

Strong play across the board. We had a couple situations with dangerous contact. Both teams had involvement. Both teams handled it well and appropriately. 

SOUP is a team with great spirit and desire to play a tough but clean game.  Appreciated the SOTG that overlayed the competition.
Great game. Good spirit all around. Good communication on calls. Could not ask for more.

Great and competitive game against Surly. These are two teams who have deep relationships across the board. Great spirit on the sideline and camaraderie. On the field there was tough play, but nothing dangerous. Things did get chippy here and there, but overall it was resolved.
Appreciated the competitive game mixed with the friendly attitude. We had some calls with disagreements, and yet, as you would, hope, we were able to resolve.

Always a hot game against Relics. Both teams had calls and energy was high. Generally worked them through. Good communication between spirit captains. I think both teams would say there were some questionable calls. We certainly would. In general, we expected to be a highly contested game. The one thing that the team objects strongly is the fact that Relics likes to bump the handler or even wrap around them on the mark. It is not an unintentional act—it is an intentional strategy. Bummer.

Best communication between teams yet. Spirit captains had great conversation about the difference between with WFDF and USAU rules. Friendly, spirited, competitive. What a great game and a great team to play.
Great game against Kingdome. Guys, we played often on for years. My played and smooth game.

What an excellent game. Endless sunset played hard and they played fast. They required full effort and played with great spirit across the board not only were they friendly on the sideline, but also during stoppages.
This team was Topps. They showed the best spirit I’ve ever seen in a game ever. They had a short crew and despite that played their best and we’re amazing.
This game started off overly physical and it impacted the score. After discussion, it was addressed and got better.

spiritreceived.comments: General demeanor solid. There were several collisions during the game so some sentiment on our team that the could have played with a little more attention to avoiding harm but there was agreement that they were graceful in handling things when play was stopped.
Thank you! Let's play again somewhere!
Dangerous play took out one of our players.
Fantastic spirit circle - player spoke and sang in Korean.
